sentences.l1: Bees are a kind of insect.
They like to fly to flowers.

sentences.l2: 蜜蜂从花里采蜜，身上会沾上花粉。
sentences.l1: Bees collect nectar from flowers, and pollen sticks to their bodies.

sentences.l2: 当它飞到另一朵花时，花粉会掉下来。
sentences.l1: When it flies to another flower, the pollen falls off.

sentences.l2: 这样，花就能结出果实和种子。
sentences.l1: In this way, the flower can bear fruit and seeds.

sentences.l2: 很多水果和蔬菜都是这样长出来的。
sentences.l1: Many fruits and vegetables grow this way.

sentences.l2: 没有蜜蜂，农业会有大问题。
sentences.l1: Without bees, agriculture would have big problems.

sentences.l2: 农民种的很多植物需要蜜蜂帮忙。
sentences.l1: Many plants that farmers grow need bees' help.

sentences.l2: 其他昆虫也可以帮忙，但蜜蜂是最勤劳的。
sentences.l1: Other insects can also help, but bees are the most hardworking.

sentences.l2: 它们每天可以飞很远，去很多花上。
sentences.l1: They can fly far every day, going to many flowers.

sentences.l2: 一个健康的生态系统需要很多不同的生物。
sentences.l1: A healthy ecosystem needs many different organisms.

sentences.l2: 如果蜜蜂变少了，其他动植物也会受影响。
sentences.l1: If bees decrease, other animals and plants will also be affected.

sentences.l2: 最近有研究发现，蜜蜂的数量在减少。
sentences.l1: Recently, research has found that the number of bees is decreasing.

sentences.l2: 我们要保护蜜蜂，保护大自然。
sentences.l1: We must protect bees and protect nature.
